notes:
v4.6.3 — TRUE silent installer + server-credential diagnostic

🐛 FIXED
• Update loop, for real this time. Previous auto-updates used '/SP- /NORESTART' Inno flags which only suppressed the welcome page — the wizard still popped up and waited for the user to click Install. Users dismissed APEX's 'Download complete' toast and never realized the wizard was waiting behind another window, so v4.6.1 and v4.6.2 auto-updates never actually installed. This release uses /VERYSILENT /SUPPRESSMSGBOXES /CLOSEAPPLICATIONS + explicit relaunch so the install happens with zero interaction. After you install v4.6.3 manually once, all future updates apply silently in the background and you're back to a working APEX with the new version, no clicks needed.
• Cloud DAY/CRYPTO bots getting 401 even though keys looked fine locally: root cause was that the APEX server's encrypted credential blob had stale data from an old sync, and clicking 'Sync keys to APEX server' in earlier builds had no visible verification you could trust. The v4.6.1 auto-sync (now correctly installed via the new silent updater) fires on every Save slots and the new tools/diagnose_alpaca_keys.py script lets you compare local vs server keys at any time and force-sync from the CLI if the UI button fails.

🛠 NEW DIAGNOSTIC
• tools/diagnose_alpaca_keys.py — run from a terminal and it (a) tests each Alpaca slot in your local .env against Alpaca's paper API, (b) fetches what the APEX server has encrypted for your user, (c) diffs the two side by side, and (d) if anything is stale, force-pushes the local keys to the server using your stored auth token. Removes all guesswork from cloud bot auth failures.
